scoring_justification: Checker independently solves spinodal and critical conditions using the continuous thermodynamics model with published parameters; agent values compared against recomputed reference with tolerances.

outputs.description: Agent's computed spinodal and critical values compared to a hidden reference recomputation using the same model equations and parameters.

output_contract.notes: The agent must use the publicly provided model parameters and polymer distribution parameters to compute the four output quantities. No parameter fitting is required.

steps.description: Recompute spinodal temperatures at X=0.048, P=20 and 100 bar, and the UCST critical minimum (T_min, P_min) using parameter set 2; compare with tolerances: 0.5 K for temperatures, 1.0 bar for pressure.
